why: keys, roles, audit and docs all right
prompt:
Protect the API with keys and roles.
- Requests carry `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Keys live in the data as `apiKeys: [{ "key", "name", "role" }]`; add one key per role to data/seed.json.
- Roles: `viewer` may only read (GET). `cook` may also cook recipes, record waste, log temperatures and enter stock-take counts. `manager` may do everything.
- A request without a key or with an unknown key is 401; a known key without permission is 403. Both answer in the usual error shape with their own error codes.
- Every request that changes data writes an audit entry (time, key name, method, path, status). `GET /audit` lists them newest first and is for managers only.
Update the existing tests so they send a key.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer:
API keys and roles are in. `npm test` (29 pass) and `npm run lint` are clean. I did not bump the schema version: the existing CLI and migration tests assert version 2 and I can't edit them. A file without `apiKeys` still opens, but it has no valid keys, so every request gets 401. This is noted in `docs/DATA.md`.

- **Auth:** missing or unknown key gives 401 `unauthorized`. A known key without permission gives 403 `forbidden`. Both use the usual error shape, and `src/errors.js` and `src/i18n/messages.js` have the new codes and English messages.
- **Roles:** `viewer` can GET anything except `/audit`. `cook` can also POST cook, waste, temperatures and stock-take counts. `manager` can do everything.
- **Audit:** every non-GET request with a known key writes an entry (`at`, `keyName`, `method`, `path`, `status`). It is also written when the request is refused with 403 or fails with an error. 401 requests are not logged, since there is no key name. `GET /audit` lists entries newest first, for managers only.
- **Keys:** `data/seed.json` has one key per role (`viewer-key-1`, `cook-key-1`, `manager-key-1`). I added the same keys to `data/db.json`, which was an identical copy of the seed, so the running server stays usable.
- **Tests:** the existing tests now send the manager key through the helper in `tests/helpers.js`. I also added `tests/auth.test.js`, which wasn't asked for, covering 401, 403 and the audit trail.
- **Docs:** `README.md`, `docs/API.md`, `docs/DATA.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated.
